name: fire_trigger
description: Fire a Routine (scheduled trigger) immediately, outside of its schedule. The Routine must belong to the calling session's account. Optionally include a text message that is appended as an extra user turn after the Routine's configured prompt, to pass run-specific context into that one firing.

text.description: Optional text appended as an extra user message after the Routine's configured prompt. Bounded to 64 KiB.
